MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items meets a current need closely enough for me to choose it. Screws, nails and a tap wrench require specific building tasks that my past purchases do not establish.",
    "The relay relates to my electronics interests, but its 110/120V AC coil does not directly match my earlier 5V relay module; the electrical requirements matter more than the shared name.",
    "The replacement belt needs a matching machine, while copper scraps, thin CA glue and vibration pads need a clear application before I would buy them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My occasional DIY purchases seem to have been taken as a broad interest in stocking construction hardware and workshop supplies.",
    "Buying one relay seems to have been treated as interest in other relays regardless of voltage or how I would connect them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, PCB supplies, jumper wires and 5V relay point toward small electronics projects where compatible components are useful together.",
    "My caster purchase suggests a particular mobility or leveling task, but it does not establish a need for vibration pads or general building supplies.",
    "I buy moderately and need a concrete use for an item; a loose connection to DIY work is not enough, especially for bulk supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "My practical DIY interests were recognized broadly, but the recommendations missed the specific tasks and component compatibility that would make an item useful to me now."
}
